title: sprite-plausibility-v1 task input
description: A table of reported summary statistics. Each row reports a mean, SD, and N for a measure scored on an integer response scale [scale_min, scale_max]. The player must judge, per statistic, whether the reported (mean, SD) pair is GRANULARITY/RANGE-plausible — i.e. whether ANY sample of N integers in that range can actually produce that mean and SD. This is SPRITE-style (rsprite2) summary-stat plausibility checking.

statistics.description: The reported summary statistics. One entry per measure.

stat_id.description: Stable id for this statistic row.

label.description: Human-readable name of the measure as reported.

n.description: Reported sample size (number of integer responses).

scale_min.description: Smallest integer the response scale allows.

scale_max.description: Largest integer the response scale allows.

decimals.description: Number of decimals the mean and SD are reported to.
